criteria.silhouette_scale: One-block controllers retain existing structure scale; recognizable broad doors stay within faces.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Layered hardware and full cube stove/fertilizer faces are native static models; no new protruding apparatus required.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: No moving parts, exposed mechanisms or new pipes. Illustrated Smithy embers will remain dark because its open hearth already supplies fire.
criteria.period_materials: Iron doors, functional brass latches, copper processing cabinet and cast-iron range fit practical town industry.
criteria.family_consistency: All share clear broad castings and quiet material patches, distinct from civic emblems and industrial gauges.
criteria.controls_readability: Brick, pouring crucible, loaf, sprout and anvil marks complement door form. User rejected paired stove circles as eyes/breasts; referenced cooktop correction replaces them with one rectangular ridged cookplate.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Illustration captions are not game rules; no organic compost mechanic or live gauge is added. Existing inputs, recipes and structures unchanged.

criteria.matches_direction: Door forms and clear material/process marks retained. User correction applied: one rectangular griddle with straight ribs replaces twin circular stove plates.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Pack-aware full masonry cubes with bounded north overlays; original stone/brick remains visible. Stove and copper furnace retain native orientable cubes.
criteria.material_consistency: Shared bounded iron and copper palettes, common brightness lift; stove/copper faces have protected perimeter and corners. Body colors exactly identical between hot/cold variants.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Existing physical structures and controller directions retained. Smithy original borrowed blast-furnace patch replaced by a larger readable anvil draft gate on its same block.
criteria.animation_states: Only inspection/window rectangles change for four lit textures; Smithy gate static beneath real hearth. No emissive body flags or new animation.
criteria.native_size_readability: Native 32px sheet reviewed: distinct brick/crucible/anvil/sprout/loaf silhouettes, visible cast-metal variation and brass pulls. Rectangular stove top has no eye-like circles.

criteria.photon_materials: Actual Photon/Faithful cold/lit/rear views reviewed: pack masonry matches structures, cast iron stays distinct from copper and brick.
criteria.scale_readability: Broad door silhouettes and process emblems remain visible; rectangular ridged stove top removes paired circular face-like pattern.
criteria.states_motion: Lit windows show embers with unchanged casing; Smithy real hearth burns above static gate.
criteria.interaction_guides: Existing structures assembled by fixture; geometry and directions retained. Guide interaction not retested for texture-only changes.
criteria.inventory_appearance: All five native models visible in inventory hotbar, with matching materials and no missing textures.
criteria.integration_limits: Recommended Photon/Faithful reviewed; other shaders and moving vessels not checked. Fixture has unrelated old display frames dropping during updates; no gameplay changes introduced.
